title: Legendary Actor Don Cheadle Talks Briefly About Upcoming Appearances In The Marvel Universe
htmlContent:
Legendary actor Don Cheadle recently came out to support his friend and comedian George Lopez and help raise awareness and money for his foundation, focusing on Kidney Disease Awareness.

During Cheadle's appearance, he was interviewed by Nick Hamilton with Nitecast Media and the host of TMA With Nick Hamilton on Siriusxm/Slamradioxm. Hamilton asked Cheadle about upcoming projects during the interview, including being a part of the Marvel Universe as War Machine.

"It's ongoing Armor Wars is happening soon, [and] The Rhode Show. Secret Invasion, Nick Fury's [played by Samuel L. Jackson] show, and Rhode [will make an appearance]," said Cheadle.

"So, we have been doing it for a minute and it's going to keep going. You will see, I can't say too much, you understand that!"

Speaking of Cheadle, he and Adam Scott recently teamed up to produce a voter suppression tv drama called 'Quitman 10+2, ' according to Shania Russell of Slashfilm.com.

Per Scott, "The events of Quitman 10+2 jumped out to us immediately as an incredibly compelling story of racial division and voter suppression that absolutely required a deeper dive. Don and I are so excited to be working with Adam and Naomi Scott as creative partners to bring this story to light."
